authority_limit: Defines a programming-language-agnostic HTTP interface description, not domain command/query meaning, authorization, aggregate correctness, effect safety, or business acceptance.
contradictory_evidence: The specification explicitly defines an interface description for HTTP APIs and includes implementation-defined or undefined behavior; it is not a business semantic authority.
counterexample_or_negative_twin: A valid OpenAPI operation can describe a POST while the represented command is unauthorized or violates an aggregate invariant.
exact_bounded_claim_supported: OpenAPI 3.2.0 defines a standard language-agnostic description of HTTP API interfaces for discovery and interaction.
invalidation_condition: Reopen if the cited edition changes its interface-description scope or a stronger primary authority contradicts this bounded claim.
title: OpenAPI Specification 3.2.0

authority_limit: Defines a vendor-neutral event-data envelope and context attributes, not domain payload meaning, delivery guarantees, consumer authorization, or exactly-once business processing.
contradictory_evidence: CloudEvents separates context metadata from domain-specific event data and leaves extension meaning and encryption agreements outside the core specification.
counterexample_or_negative_twin: A syntactically conforming CloudEvent can be duplicated, delivered out of order, carry a semantically invalid payload, or be consumed without authority.
exact_bounded_claim_supported: CloudEvents 1.0 defines vendor-neutral event format, required/optional context attributes, and serialization-independent envelope metadata distinct from domain event data.
invalidation_condition: Reopen if the cited specification changes its envelope/data boundary or a stronger primary authority contradicts this bounded claim.
organization_or_authors: Cloud Native Computing Foundation CloudEvents project
title: CloudEvents Specification 1.0

authority_limit: Defines HTTP request-method semantics at the protocol boundary, not domain idempotency, transactional atomicity, authorization, or outcome acceptance.
contradictory_evidence: RFC 9110 defines idempotence by intended server effect for identical requests; incidental effects and application-level invariants remain outside that protocol definition.
counterexample_or_negative_twin: An HTTP PUT can be protocol-idempotent while emitting duplicate notifications or violating a domain-level exactly-once obligation.
exact_bounded_claim_supported: RFC 9110 defines safe and idempotent HTTP request-method semantics and identifies PUT, DELETE, and safe methods as idempotent at that boundary.
invalidation_condition: Reopen if HTTP semantics are superseded or a stronger primary authority contradicts this bounded interpretation.
title: HTTP Semantics, RFC 9110

authority_limit: Defines a general-purpose event-based state-machine notation and execution model, not domain state ownership, persistence durability, effect authorization, or provider qualification.
contradictory_evidence: SCXML defines legal state configurations and transition processing while external communications and executable content remain explicit separate mechanisms.
counterexample_or_negative_twin: A legal SCXML transition can represent an application state change that is forbidden by the domain aggregate or cannot be durably committed.
exact_bounded_claim_supported: W3C SCXML 1.0 defines event-driven state configurations, transitions, hierarchical/parallel states, and run-to-completion processing semantics.
invalidation_condition: Reopen if the cited recommendation changes its state-machine scope or a stronger primary authority contradicts this bounded claim.
title: State Chart XML (SCXML) 1.0

authority_limit: Defines business-process notation and control-flow vocabulary, not the execution guarantees of a particular engine, domain authority, or authority to perform effects.
contradictory_evidence: A process notation can describe activities and flow without proving that any task is authorized, executable, compensated, or accepted.
counterexample_or_negative_twin: A valid BPMN model can contain a service task whose external effect is unavailable, unauthorized, or irreversible.
exact_bounded_claim_supported: OMG BPMN 2.0.2 supplies standardized business-process notation and workflow control-flow concepts.
invalidation_condition: Reopen if the cited specification changes its notation boundary or a stronger primary authority contradicts this bounded claim.
title: Business Process Model and Notation 2.0.2

authority_limit: Defines provenance entities, activities, agents, and relations; it does not prove the truth, correctness, independent assurance, authorization, or business acceptance of a recorded outcome.
contradictory_evidence: A provenance graph records asserted relations and derivations but does not independently validate the asserted event or outcome.
counterexample_or_negative_twin: A complete PROV-DM derivation can faithfully record that a faulty process produced an incorrect result.
exact_bounded_claim_supported: W3C PROV-DM defines entities, activities, agents, and usage, generation, communication, invalidation, and collection relations for provenance descriptions.
invalidation_condition: Reopen if the cited recommendation changes its provenance boundary or a stronger primary authority contradicts this bounded claim.
title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model

authority_limit: Motivates long-lived transaction decomposition and explicit compensating transactions; it does not make compensation equivalent to rollback, prove semantic correctness, or confer effect authority.
contradictory_evidence: Compensation is a separately designed transaction after partial progress, not restoration of an unknowable universal prior state.
counterexample_or_negative_twin: Refunding a payment may compensate a charge while failing to reverse shipment, disclosure, notification, or an external market effect.
exact_bounded_claim_supported: Garcia-Molina and Salem's Sagas paper models a long-lived transaction as component transactions with associated compensating transactions.
invalidation_condition: Reopen if stronger primary research changes the compensation boundary or contradicts this bounded claim.
title: Sagas
